simple.meaning: נֶגַע (negaʻ) is a Hebrew object word meaning “a blow (figuratively, infliction); also (by implication) a spot (concretely, a leprous person or dress).” BibleIQ follows the concrete thing through the verses where it appears.
simple.biblicalBackground: The occurrence trail begins at Genesis 12:17. The surrounding context includes family line, priesthood, Egypt.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to נֶגַע (H5061) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: Concrete words often carry patterns through Scripture because objects, animals, offerings, and created things are used repeatedly in worship, judgment, covenant, and narrative.
